builds.name: Reference: Contact fighter
builds.goal: Reference for Vi: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A melee diver who isolates a target through charged Q or targeted R and follows with attacks to shred armor. Ability hits trigger her shield, making cast timing relevant to survival. Measure W three-hit armor shred, shield cadence and Q/R approach. Physical burst must repay lower survivability after landing on the target; do not grant immediate full shred. Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.
builds.summary: Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.
testPlan: Kit question for Vi: Measure W three-hit armor shred, shield cadence and Q/R approach. Physical burst must repay lower survivability after landing on the target; do not grant immediate full shred.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Vi charges her gauntlets and unleashes a vault shattering punch, carrying her forward. Enemies she hits are knocked back and receive a stack of Denting Blows. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Physical pressure or sustained contact must justify these purchases; MR and healing slots are matchup dependent.

The route fails Vi's stated kit question: Measure W three-hit armor shred, shield cadence and Q/R approach. Physical burst must repay lower survivability after landing on the target; do not grant immediate full shred.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Physical pressure or sustained contact must justify these purchases; MR and healing slots are matchup dependent.
Full cost 16,800 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Sterak's Gage, Death's Dance, Spirit Visage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Vi singles out an enemy champion, revealing them and dashing unstoppably towards them. Upon reaching them, Vi Knocks them Up for [1.3] seconds and deals [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.

Any other enemies Vi collides with are dealt damage, knocked aside, and Stunned for [0.75] seconds.

Begin Charging: Vi begins charging a powerful punch, Slowing herself by [15]%.

Release: Vi dashes forward dealing between [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] and [(40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (2.5)] physical damage based on charge time and applying Denting Blows to all enemies hit. Vi stops upon colliding with an enemy champion, and Knocks them Back.

Vi's next Attack deals [10 / 30 / 50 / 70 / 90 + (1.1) × AD + (1) × AP] physical damage to the target and enemies behind them.

This Ability has 2 charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).
Vi gains [(0.1) × Stat(12)] Shield for [3] seconds after hitting an enemy or structure with an activated Ability.

Passive: Every 3rd Attack on the same target deals an additional [(4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 + (0.035) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (0.01)] max Health physical damage, removes [20]% Armor and grants Vi [30 / 35 / 40 / 45 / 50]% Attack Speed for [4] seconds. It also reduces the remaining Cooldown of Blast Shield by @spell.ViPassive:CDReductionOn3Hit@ seconds.

builds.name: Relentless AP punch
builds.summary: Test relentless ap punch against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test relentless ap punch against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Relentless Force has 1.0 AP physical scaling across the attack and cone; Nashor and Dusk and Dawn add separate magic on-hits while Gunblade retains AD for Q/W. Two E charges allow a short punch sequence, with Denting Blows contributing physical armor reduction.
testPlan: Required state: Get into attack range with Q and spend E on real attack resets.
Measure cone physical damage and target magic item packets separately.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Weak Q/R burst and few defenses leave Vi exposed after entry.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: AP does not make E magic and each enemy in the cone does not receive all owner on-hits.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Hextech Gunblade, Rabadon's Deathcap, Terminus, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.goal: Test blast shield health converter against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Blast Shield grants 10% source health after an activated ability hits; Bloodmail supplies AD from item health and Visage supports the shield. Denting Blows' every-third attack reduces the passive cooldown and adds max-health physical damage, while Titanic reinforces actual attacks.
